text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Bournemouth and Burnley.
Bournemouth are winless in their first nine Premier League games and are in the relegation zone after collecting just three points.
They have had a difficult start under new manager Andoni Iraola and lost to Wolves in their last outing, with former Cherries boss Gary O’Neil leading his new side to a 2-1 victory.
Bournemouth have been beaten in four successive matches, with their last point coming against Chelsea in a goalless draw.
They have lost six of their previous eight league matches against Burnley (winning two), including their last four encounters.
They desperately need a positive result as they face Manchester City and Newcastle United in their next two top-flight fixtures.
Championship winners Burnley have also had a slow start and are just one place and one point above Bournemouth in the Premier League.
Vincent Kompany’s men have lost four of their last five, with their solitary win coming against Luton Town.
Only Sheffield United have conceded more than the Clarets this campaign, who are without a clean sheet this term.
All of their points have come away from home this season, also drawing with Nottingham Forest, but they will have to recover quickly from their thumping against Brentford.
Burnley lost 3-0 against the Bees at the Gtech Community Stadium, with Yoane Wissa, Bryan Mbeumo and Saman Ghoddos all scoring.
Bournemouth make four changes to the side that lost to Wolves in their last match.
Radu replaces Neto in goal, with the former Barcelona man out through injury.
Mepham comes into the side and Zabarnyi moves over to left-back, meaning Kerkez drops onto the bench.
Cook is suspended and is replaced in the midfield by Christie.
Finally, Semenyo comes in for Brooks.
Burnley make five alterations to the team that were defeated by Brentford.
Connor Roberts was sent off against the Bees and is replaced at right-back by Vitinho.
Brownhill and Gudmundsson come into the midfield, with Cullen retaining his place in the middle.
Berge, Tresor, and Odobert are on the bench, but Lyle Foster is completely out of the squad.
Koleosho and Zaroury start on the wing, with Amdouni pushing up front.
Bournemouth have lost just one of their 16 Premier League home games against promoted sides (winning nine and drawing six), going down 1-0 against Fulham in April 2019.
The match is moments away from starting.
Burnley get this Premier League clash under way.
Both teams have struggled in front of goal this season and will want to change that in what is a crucial match at the bottom of the table.
Only Luton Town (22) have had fewer shots on target in the Premier League this season than Burnley (24), who also have the second lowest expected goals tally (7.7).
However, Bournemouth have scored the fewest goals (six) and have the lowest shot conversion rate (5.9 per cent) of any side this term.
Billing drives into Burnley's half and approaches the box before sliding a pass down the left to Solanke.
He attempts to poke the ball past O'Shea, but the defender slides across and makes a vital tackle.
It then rebounds off Solanke and goes out for a goal-kick.
Semenyo moves his body from right to left to fool a defender on the wing.
He rushes into space and moves inside before playing a pass across to Tavernier, who directs the ball back across the box.
However, Koleosho gets back to make the interception.
Burnley win a corner on the left and play it short.
Gudmundsson then curls a cross into the box that is headed over by Amdouni.
Koleosho collects the ball on the right and is up against Kelly.
He looks to go around the Bournemouth captain, but the defender uses his strength and steps across to win possession.
Bournemouth have three players over a free-kick on the right.
Tavernier takes it and whips a shot towards the corner with his left foot, with Trafford getting across to punch it behind.
Kelly gets onto the end of the following corner and hooks a shot towards the goal, but his effort is tame and Trafford collects it.
Burnley load the box for a corner on the left.
They play it short again and work the ball out to the edge of the box, with Taylor's ambitious effort deflecting behind for a corner.
GOALLL! TAYLOR SCORES! 1-0 BURNLEY! What a strike from the defender.
A corner from the left is headed away by Zabarnyi, but O'Shea is there and he knocks it back to Taylor, who crashes his shot past Radu.
O'Shea's header to Taylor is perfect.
It drops straight to the scorer, who keeps his eye on the ball before shooting past Radu with an excellent first-time strike.

Burnley have won their last three Premier League away games against Bournemouth – only against Man Utd (five between 1914 and 1921) and Blackburn Rovers (four between 1962 and 1966) have they won more consecutively on the road in the top-flight.
They have started well today.
Bournemouth have not started the game well and are now being put under pressure by Burnley, who are full of confidence after their early goal.
A long ball out of Bournemouth's defence is aimed towards Semenyo, but there is too much height on it and it goes straight to Trafford.
Burnley are pressing Bournemouth's defence well and are not allowing them to keep the ball for extended periods of time.
The hosts have looked to go long on a few occasions but have wasted possession.
OVER! Bournemouth should be level! Semenyo races down the right and whips an inviting cross into the box.
Trafford cannot get there and Tavernier has the chance to put it in from close range but shoots over.
GOALLL! SEMENYO SCORES! 1-1! Semenyo wins possession off Taylor in Burnley's half and rushes into the box.
He has Tavernier to his left, but he drives his low strike across the goal and into the bottom corner.
There is a short VAR check for a possible foul, but the goal stands.
Burnley haven’t kept a clean sheet in any of their last 15 Premier League games, their longest run without a top-flight shutout since a run of 29 between November 2009 and August 2014.
Bournemouth have the momentum now.
Semenyo carries the ball into Burnley's half and looks to find Solanke with a throughball.
He cannot get there and Al Dakhil pokes it back to Trafford, but the goalkeeper sends it straight out for a throw-in.
Gudmundsson's corner from the left is headed away, and Burnley have a throw-in on the other side.
However, Bournemouth commit men over to that side and win it back almost immediately.
Cullen is the first player to go into the book after fouling Aarons, who was breaking forward.
The linesman is tripped by a sprinkler on the line and the game stops.
However, the match gets back under way after a brief delay.
The game has changed since Bournemouth netted the equaliser.
The Cherries are in the ascendancy and are controlling the tempo of the game.
Burnley are struggling to get out of their half.
Koleosho pushes past Kelly on the right and curls a searching ball into the box.
Amdouni rushes towards it, but he cannot get his head on the ball to direct it towards the goal.
Vitinho plays a pass down the wing to Koleosho, who uses his pace to get past Kelly for the second time.
He flashes a low cross into the box, but Scott get back to clear it away.
Zaroury then has a shot from the edge of the box, but Radu collects it with ease.
SAVE! Tavernier is over a corner on the left and he whips a dangerous cross into the box.
Mepham gets away from his marker and is free, but his header is pushed over by Trafford after two attempts.
Tavernier goes over to the right to take the next corner.
However, Trafford rushes off his line and clears it away.
Bournemouth have had four corners in this game and have caused problems in Burnley's box with most of them.
The original cross is punched away by Trafford, but Billing directs the ball back in.
However, Mepham scuffs his shot on the turn.
Semenyo comes inside from the right and looks for the bottom corner with a low strike, but his effort deflects just wide off Taylor, hitting the side of the net on the way through.
There will be three minutes of additional time.
Semenyo rushes down the right side of the pitch to try and get onto the end of a long ball forward.
He gets into a race with Trafford and gets his toe onto the end of it, but Trafford pushes it away from his path.
There are calls for handball, but the referee allows the game to continue.
Solanke has been quiet in this half but does well to move inside from the left before having his shot from the edge of the box blocked by Cullen.
Billing recovers the loose ball but shoots over from distance.
HALF-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 1-1 BURNLEY
Semenyo scored his second Premier League goal of the season to send Bournemouth and Burnley into half-time with the score level.
Taylor netted a stunning opener for the visitors, getting on the end of O'Shea's headed pass and blasting his controlled strike past Radu.

events.action: blasting his controlled strike past Radu

text: Tavernier missed the target from close range before Semenyo netted the equaliser.
He won possession off Taylor and drove into the box.
He ignored options around him and drilled his low strike across the goal and into the bottom corner.
The Cherries dominated after scoring but couldn't find a second.
Mepham's header was well saved by Trafford, with Solanke having his shot blocked just before the break.
Bournemouth will be disappointed that they couldn't capitalise on their momentum after scoring.
The hosts controlled possession and stopped Burnley from breaking forward regularly.
Solanke didn't have his usual level of impact for his side, but Semenyo was excellent.
He was constantly looking to receive the ball and drive into Burnley's defence third with possession.
As for the Clarets, they need to be more versatile in the attack.
Koleosho has had the beating of Kelly on the right, but they have only looked like scoring from corners and crosses from open play.
They are missing Foster in the attack.
Burnley make a change before the restart.
Amdouni is replaced by Rodriguez up front.
Bournemouth get the ball rolling again.
Bournemouth win a free-kick in on the right just outside the box after Aarons is fouled by Zaroury.
Tavernier whips a shot towards the goal, but Trafford pushes it away.
Zaroury breaks down the left and tries to move past Aarons on the inside, but the former Norwich City man wins possession with an excellent slide tackle.
Christie collects it and looks for Solanke with a direct pass forward but sends the ball out for a goal-kick.
Tavernier receives the ball inside Burnley's half and goes inside before offloading it to Semenyo.
He has time and space but takes too long, allowing defenders to get back and win it off him.
Mepham launches a long ball forward, with Solanke only able to head it up into the air on the edge of the box.
He races towards it and tries to get there before Trafford, but the goalkeeper collects it.
Solanke collides with him and stays down for a brief period before returning to his feet.
Burnley have won just one of their last 13 Premier League games (drawing two and losing 10), beating Luton 2-1 earlier this month.
However, their previous eight points in the top-flight have all been won in away games.
They have not been able to wrestle back control of the game since the restart, with Bournemouth still looking threatening on the attack.
Aarons gets the better of Taylor on the outside and goes past the defender.
However, the defender stops him from getting into the box with a foul and collects a yellow card.
Tavernier is over a free-kick on the right and sends a low pass into the feet of Semenyo.
He protects the ball well from Brownhill before blasting the ball straight at Trafford from a tight angle.
O'Shea's clearance is poor and Trafford rushes off his line to claim.
He brushes past Solanke on the way through, with the Bournemouth striker hitting the deck.
The hosts want a penalty, but the contact was very soft.
Burnley make their first change.
Berge comes on for Cullen in the midfield.
Mepham chips a pass over the top of Burnley's defence and into the path of Tavernier on the left side of the box.
He volleys a shot across the goal that is pushed away by Trafford.
The flag then goes up for offside.
Scott shows some tricky feet and rushes past a couple of defenders.
He gets to the byline and cuts a pass back to Semenyo, but he cannot get a shot away.
Gudmundsson gets back to poke the ball behind for a corner.
Bournemouth have a couple of corners in a matter of minutes.
Scott takes the first, but O'Shea heads it behind.
The next cross from the right is inviting, but there is a foul on Trafford in the middle and Burnley have it back.
Billing moves over to the left and curls a low cross into the heart of the box.
Solanke gets there ahead of his marker but shoots straight at Trafford.
Al Dakhil is given a yellow card for a foul on Christie.
OVER! Scott is over the resulting free-kick on the left, with the midfielder whipping his shot over the wall and wide and just over.
Burnley make a change on the wing.
Larsen is on for Zaroury.
Semenyo makes his way off after an energetic performance in Bournemouth's attack.
Ouattara takes his place to try and make an impact.
Burnley manager Kompany will be disappointed with his attack in this half.
They have not had a shot since the break.
Rodriguez fouls Scott in Bournemouth's half after Burnley give away possession in a dangerous position.
A sign of frustration from the striker, who has not been able to get into the game.
GOALLL! BILLING SCORES! 2-1 BOURNEMOUTH! That could be a vital goal for the hosts! Burnley are poor in possession again, with Vitinho gifting the ball to Billing around the halfway line.
The midfielder spots Trafford off his line and chips the goalkeeper.
He gets a glove on it but cannot keep it out.
Billing takes off his shirt and is shown a yellow card.
There is still work to do for Bournemouth.
No team have dropped more points from winning positions in the Premier League this season than the Cherries (11).
One last throw of the dice for Burnley.
They are about to make their last two substitutions.
Burnley make a couple of changes.
Koleosho was lively in the first half but has been nullified since the restart.
Tresor comes on in the attack.
Redmond is also introduced.
He replaces Gudmundsson.
Iraola brings on another defender.
Kerkez comes on for Tavernier.
Billing scored Bournemouth's second and is now coming off.
Rothwell takes his place in the midfield.
Redmond collects the ball in the middle and launches it down the left, but threre is nobody there.
Aarons gets in a race against Tresor and gets there before the Burnley man.
Ouattara goes into the book for time wasting.
Aarons went down a couple of minutes ago and is now coming off.
Smith is on.
Burnley clear the ball away, but it drops to Kerkez on the left.
He drives a powerful shot towards the goal that defelcts into the hands of Trafford.
The Bournemouth substitute wastes possession and the away side have a chance to attack.
OFFSIDE BUT THERE IS A VAR CHECK! Burnley thought they had netted an equaliser.
Redmond rushes through the heart of Bournemouth's half and sends a throughball into the path of Rodriguez.
He controls it well and sends his effort across the goal and into the corner.
The flag goes up, but there is a VAR check.
There will be seven minutes of additional time.
The VAR check is still ongoing.
Rodriguez is waiting to see if he has netted Burnley's equaliser.
Four minutes have passed since the ball hit the back of the net.
FINAL DECISION OFFSIDE! There was a very long VAR check to see if Rodriguez was in an offside position when Redmond played the pass into him before scoring.
However, the offside decision stands and the game continues.
Bournemouth have everyone behind the ball and are clearing it long at every opportunity.
There will be more than the seven additional minutes that were allocated after an extended delay.
SAVE AND OVER! What a chance for Burnley! The away side go short with a corner.
Taylor curls the ball into the box and Berge meets it.
His initial header is pushed away by Radu, with the midfielder shooting over with the rebound.
Larsen rushes down the right and tries to beat Kelly on the outside, but the Bournemouth captain gets across to win possession before clearing the ball up the pitch.
CHANCE! Berge has a late opportunity to score, but his effort deflects into the hands of Radu.
FULL-TIME: BOURNEMOUTH 2-1 BURNLEY
Billing scored a stunning goal for Bournemouth as the Cherries came from behind to win in the Premier League for the first time this season.
Taylor broke the deadlock for Burnley with a sublime strike.
O'Shea headed the ball into the path of the defender, who thumped his effort past Radu from the edge of the box.
Tavernier somehow directed his shot over from close range before Semenyo netted the equaliser.
He won possession off of Taylor and rushed forward with the ball.
He moved into the box and drilled his effort across the goal and into the bottom corner.
Billing netted the winner in the second half.
Vitinho gifted possession to the midfielder around the halfway line.
Billing spotted Trafford off his line and chipped him from distance.
Rodriguez thought he had scored a late equaliser for the away side after getting on the end of a throughball and shooting past Radu.
However, a prolonged VAR check stuck with the offside decision.
Berge had the final opportunity, but he had a shot saved before blasting over.
Next up, attention turns to the EFL Cup.
Bournemouth host Liverpool and Burnley go to Everton.
That's all for today, goodbye.
